en: A colorized historical postcard view of a stone bridge crossing a wide river and leading into a grand baroque cityscape. On the right side, a large church with tall spires and ornate towers dominates the scene, while a red-and-yellow electric tram and horse-drawn carriages cross the bridge. The buildings have red and green roofs and detailed façades. The sky is blue with light clouds. Printed captions at the top read the city name and the bridge name, with a handwritten number in red ink.
